cohort: The study included 9962 Chinese students aged 6-18 years, comprising 4981 with high birth weight and 4981 with normal birth weight, sampled from seven provinces.
finding: High birth weight was positively associated with an increased risk of overweight (OR=1.230) and obesity (OR=1.611) in Chinese students aged 6-18 years.
birth_weight: High birth weight (HBW) and normal birth weight (NBW)
